<!--
Write for the reviewer, not for the template. Summarize the intent and the
important decisions in natural language; do not mechanically restate the diff.
A concise handoff to another engineer beats a file-by-file changelog.
The headings below are a starting point — keep what helps, drop what doesn't.
-->

## What changed

<!--
A short, human-readable summary: what this changes and why it changes.
Lead with the reasoning. Call out anything non-obvious about the
implementation. Skip the file-by-file narration — that's what the diff is for.
-->

## Validation

<!--
How was this verified? e.g. `tests/validate-repository.sh` — passed,
a build/package script, manual walk-through of a workflow, link checks.
"Not applicable" is a fine answer when it genuinely is.
-->

## Notes

<!--
Optional. Anything reviewers should pay special attention to: trade-offs,
follow-up work, or context that isn't visible in the diff.
Delete this section if there's nothing useful to add.
-->
